The first enabled selected branch saves and replaces target coordinates. Current-stage indexing is explicit. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/kinds/ftCommon/ftCo_0A01.c#L948-L1058.
